grammar.words: concatenated bare/single-quoted/double-quoted fragments with quote/escape provenance
grammar.whitespace: space/tab; LF list separator; CRLF one separator; standalone CR unsupported; leading/trailing blank lines allowed
grammar.escapeRules: outside quotes backslash escapes next character; double quotes only backslash, quote, dollar, backtick; escaped LF/CRLF line continuation
grammar.activeExpansion: unescaped dollar/backtick in bare or double quotes; bare *, ?, [, ~ => UNRESOLVED_EXPANSION
grammar.literalExpansion: single-quoted or validly escaped characters remain data; never parse arbitrary quoted arguments

nestedShell.shape: exact executable + exact flag + one literal command word; no other words

grammar.executableMatching: exact literal names only; no PATH lookup, basename normalization, alias or function resolution

grammar.docker: literal docker/docker-compose => DOCKER_ENDPOINT_UNKNOWN; never inspect configuration or endpoints

ssh.localityMeaning: remote execution syntax only; not verified DNS/configuration/physical topology
